telemetry.title: Fuel Telemetry
telemetry.description: Fuel consumption readings of the main and auxiliary engines from MQTT/HTTP devices, APIs and manual entry.

vessels.title: Fleet vessels
vessels.empty: No vessels in the fleet yet
vessels.emptyHint: Telemetry is available for your organization's vessels. Add a vessel first.

series.title: Fuel consumption
series.description: Main engine (ME) and auxiliary engines (AE) per reading, per hour or per day (UTC).
series.caption: Fuel consumption chart, {{bucket}}
series.emptyHint: Choose another range, check the vessel's devices or enter a manual reading.
series.truncated: The chart and table show the first {{count}} points; narrow the range or choose a coarser resolution. The CSV export holds every point.

buckets.label: Resolution
buckets.tooLong: The range is too long for this resolution

manual.title: Manual reading
manual.description: Record fuel consumption from the engine log. One reading per vessel and time; a different reading at the same time is refused.
manual.timeHint: End of the measured period (local time).
manual.periodHint: Before the reading time, at most {{hours}} hours.
manual.savedHint: Chart and summary updated; the emission service receives this reading.
manual.duplicate: The same reading is already stored (nothing changed)

errors.future: The time must not be more than 5 minutes ahead
errors.tooOld: The reading is older than 5 years
errors.periodOrder: The period start must be before the reading time
errors.periodLength: The period is at most {{hours}} hours
errors.conflict: A different reading exists at this time. Change the time or check the stored data.

devices.title: Devices
devices.emptyHint: Register an MQTT or HTTP fuel meter so telemetry flows automatically.
devices.readOnly: Device registration and settings (API keys, MQTT topics) are managed by organization admins on the Devices page.

mqtt.title: How devices report
mqtt.description: Fuel meters publish JSON on their own MQTT topic, or post over HTTP with the device's API key.
mqtt.topicHint: Replace <deviceId> with the device id from the Devices page. The NATS MQTT gateway forwards it to the telemetry service.
rules: One object or an array of up to 1000 readings; the MMSI is the device's.
Values ≥ 0 in metric tonnes; ISO-8601 UTC times, at most 5 minutes ahead.
Identical readings are ignored (idempotent); a different reading at the same time is refused as a conflict.
Only active devices of kind mqtt are accepted.
mqtt.httpHint: HTTP devices post with an API key of scope telemetry:ingest linked to the device.

FORBIDDEN.title: The vessel is not your organization's
FORBIDDEN.detail: Telemetry can only be recorded for vessels of the active organization.

ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED.title: Choose an active organization
ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED.detail: Telemetry is private to each organization.

VESSEL_NOT_FOUND.title: The telemetry service does not know the vessel
VESSEL_NOT_FOUND.detail: It may be new or deleted; try again in a moment.

DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.title: Device not found
DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.detail: The device may have been deleted.

READING_CONFLICT.title: Reading conflict
READING_CONFLICT.detail: A different reading exists at that time; nothing was stored.
